notes: Comprehensive research university in Blacksburg, Virginia. Ph.D. programs across engineering, science, computing, and life sciences.

app_fee.value: Non-refundable $75 application fee for degree-seeking students.
app_fee.quote: Degree-seeking students must include a $75 fee with their application, though check to see if you qualify for a waiver or reduced fee. All application fees are non-refundable.

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers available based on qualifying events and pipeline programs.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants may be eligible for a Virginia Tech Graduate School application fee waivers based on the qualifying events below. Documentation as evidence of eligibility must be provided for review and approval under each category.

gre_general.value: Graduate School does not centrally require entrance tests; departments set entrance test requirements.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate School does not require entrance tests, but check to see whether your department requires you to submit GRE, GMAT, or subject test scores with your application.

toefl_min.value: Minimum overall TOEFL score of 90 with 20 on each subsection (or 4.5 on scale after Jan 21, 2026).
toefl_min.quote: For TOEFL tests taken prior to January 21, 2026, a minimum overall score of 90 and 20 on each subsection score is required. Some departments may require higher minimum scores.

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS score of 6.5 required for admission.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum TOEFL score of 4.5 (IBT) or IELTS score of 6.5 is required for admission.

english_waiver.value: Waiver granted for applicants who earned a bachelor's degree from an accredited university where English is the medium of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: English proficiency can also be demonstrated through a conferred bachelor’s degree from an accredited university where English is the medium of instruction. If this applies to you, we will code a waiver of the English proficiency requirement into your application once we receive and review your transcript showing degree conferral and medium of instruction as English.
